description_en: Batch assign devices to an edge instance and set drivers for the devices
description_zh: 批量将设备分配到边缘实例中，并为设备设置驱动
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-bind-device-to-edge-instance-with-driver --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --driver-id 021d154d2a2f4dd7a489773d9e040000 --iot-ids example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchBindDeviceToEdgeInstanceWithDriver

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the edge instance. To obtain the instance ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list). On the **Edge Instances** page, move the pointer over the name of the edge instance to which you want to bind multiple devices and obtain the instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to query the instance ID.
parameters.description_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。

parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the driver. To obtain the driver ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list). On the **Drivers** page, move the pointer over the name of the driver that you want to configure and obtain the driver ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to query the driver ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en:

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to query the driver ID

parameters.description_en:
The IDs of the devices.

You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query detailed information about all devices that belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account and obtain the required device IDs.

>  You can specify a maximum of 20 device IDs when you call the BatchBindDeviceToEdgeInstanceWithDriver operation.

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。

parameters.description_en:
A list of device IDs.
You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) API to query the information of all devices under your account and obtain the IotId of each device.

> You can attach a maximum of 20 devices in a single call.
parameters.description_zh:

> 单次调用最多可绑定20个设备。
